_provenance.status: APP-AUTHORED records of the four processes the product runs today — the workflow engine does not exist
note: No workflow/config engine or contract exists, so the office cannot define its own steps, owners or order. This file records the processes the shipped modules already enforce — it is display data, not an executable definition.

The service-contract steps are case-events-v1's frozen seven-stage order (docs/08-delivery/contracts/case-events-v1.md); the lot-transfer steps are the four states of the office's own lot record (lib/lot-lifecycle.ts). tests/fixture-contract/workflows.test.ts fails on any drift from either vocabulary.
The purchase-application and chapel-booking steps are transcribed from the shipped flows (the property lot statuses + the purchase-application capture; lib/chapel-booking.ts + booking-events-v1).

The in-flight rows are NOT in this file: lib/api-client/workflows.ts reads the recorded records live (cases, lot transfers, chapel bookings, applications + lots). Nothing on the screen is invented here.

workflows.name: Funeral service
